name: SaaS Browser

sources.title: saasbrowser.io landing page — links out to saasbrowser.com
SaaS Browser — SaaS database & search engine (455k+ products)
Help: How can I add my SaaS to SaaS Browser?
Help: Which types of SaaS are added to SaaS Browser?

conditions: A saasbrowser.com account is required to submit
Submission form asks for a work email that matches the company domain
requirements: Must be a real SaaS: value delivered automatically without heavy one-to-one human work
Live landing page where visitors can sign up, buy, or book a demo today — 'coming soon' pages are rejected
Web and mobile apps both qualify
Product may already be indexed — the SaaS Browser Bot crawls the web and adds products without submission
preparation: A work email address on the product's own domain
Optional product icon/logo to complete the listing
workflow: Search saasbrowser.com first — the crawler may already list the product
Sign in / create an account at saasbrowser.com/users/sign_in
Fill the short form (name, URL, one-line description, work email) and submit
Optionally add product icon and details like pricing model, category, affiliate/bug-bounty flags
watchFor: saasbrowser.io itself is a thin gateway page — all real submission happens on saasbrowser.com
Outbound links reported as nofollow by third-party launch guides, so value is discovery/leads rather than SEO
Products can appear via crawling even without submitting; claiming/verifying may be separate from adding
countsAsLive: The product is searchable in the saasbrowser.com index and shows a detail entry under its category.
unknowns: Review/approval timeline for manually submitted products
Whether the .io domain will keep operating as a gateway or be retired
Exact verification flow for claiming an already-crawled listing
